name: MonarchAvailabilityToggle
title: AvailabilityToggle
wrapsNative: Toggle (default switch style) with a composed label
summary: A standard switch for whether automatic assignment may give someone new work, with a status word ("Available" or "Away"), a mark and an optional explanation.
whenToUse: Where work is assigned automatically and a person must be able to step out of it: an account menu, a settings screen, a home screen.
whenNotToUse: For any other setting use the standard Toggle (see switch). For presence with custom statuses use a status picker.
api: MonarchAvailabilityToggle.init(isAvailable: Binding<Bool>, isPending: Bool = false, label: String? = nil, availableLabel: String? = nil, awayLabel: String? = nil, availableHint: String? = nil, awayHint: String? = nil, pendingLabel: String? = nil, showsHint: Bool = false)

options.name: isAvailable
options.description: Whether the person is available for new work.

options.name: isPending
options.description: Whether a change is being saved. The switch is disabled and a progress indicator is shown.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name "Available for new work".

options.name: availableHint
options.description: Replaces the built-in explanation shown when available.

options.name: awayHint
options.description: Replaces the built-in explanation shown when away.

options.name: showsHint
options.description: Whether the explanation is shown under the status word and read as the hint.

states.name: available
states.description: The switch is on, the status word is "Available" and the mark is a filled dot in the success colour.

states.name: away
states.description: The switch is off, the status word is "Away" and the mark is a ring in the warning colour.

states.name: pending
states.description: The switch is disabled, a small progress indicator follows the text, and the spoken hint starts with "Saving".

states.name: disabled
states.description: The text and mark use the disabled text role and the switch is dimmed by the system, with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

appearance: The switch is the system one, tinted with the theme's accent. The status word uses the default text role and the explanation the muted role; the mark uses the success solid role when available and the warning solid role when away, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web renders nothing while the value is null; on iOS do not show the view until the value is known. The web's inMenu flag handles menu key events and has no meaning here. The mark's filled and ring shapes, used on the web only in forced-colours mode, are always used on iOS. A progress indicator is shown while pending; the web only disables the switch.
accessibility: It stays a standard Toggle: VoiceOver reads the switch role and the system's on and off values.
The spoken name is "Available for new work" (or label), not the visible status word.
With showsHint the explanation is the hint; while pending the hint starts with "Saving".
The mark is decorative and differs in shape as well as colour; the status word carries the meaning.
The row is at least 44 points high and its text wraps at large text sizes.
edgeCases: The component does not save anything. Set isPending while saving and set the binding back if saving fails.
A long status word or explanation wraps beside the switch.
Inside a List or Form the row takes the system's row insets.
